purpose: Make the best small improvement to research delegation now; revise after use.

tasks.title: Review the exact claim using existing evidence first
Put a short decision handoff in the existing abstract
Turn a broad question into one economical assignment
Try the workflow on saved investigations and prune the backlog
tasks.activate_when: The review and handoff prompts exist and can be tried against saved evidence.

tasks.title: Follow explicit dependencies only if ordinary search proves awkward
tasks.activate_when: The pilot records a recurring dependency question that current catalog search and direct links handle poorly.

tasks.title: Read saved outcomes of ended jobs without rerunning them
tasks.activate_when: A current investigation or the pilot needs an ended job's status that live status tools no longer expose; saved artifacts exist.
